answer: 过了 census date 再退课，可能产生学术和/或经济处罚：您可能要为该课支付费用，成绩记录也可能显示 Withdrawn 或 Withdrawn Fail。如果是因超出自己控制的特殊情况，可能可以申请 WDN 成绩或学费返还（fee reversal）。

points.text: 全额自费学生在 census date 之后退课，仍需支付学费。
points.quote: If you’re a full-fee paying student and you withdraw from a unit after the census date, you still need to pay the fees.
points.title: Add or withdraw from units

points.text: 如果因超出自己控制的特殊情况而在 census date 后退课或不及格，可以申请学费返还，并把不及格改为 WDN；此类情况必须在 census date 之后发生或恶化。
points.quote: Special circumstances are circumstances that were beyond your control, made it impossible for you to complete unit requirements, and occurred or worsened after the unit census date.
points.title: Fee reversal and Withdrawn grade (special circumstances)
points.section: Fee reversal and Withdrawn grade (special circumstances)

points.text: 马来西亚校区：census date 之后退课的课程不会追溯到 census date 或其他学术处罚日期之前，除非学生能证明是大学的错误。
points.quote: Units that are discontinued after the census date will not be backdated prior to the census date, or any other academic penalty date, unless University error can be demonstrated by the student.
points.title: Changing your enrolment

points.text: 在 census date 当天晚上 11:59（墨尔本时间）之前退课，可以不产生经济或学术处罚。
points.quote: You have until 11.59pm (Melbourne time) on the census date to withdraw from units without financial or academic penalty.
points.title: Census dates and teaching periods

citations.quote: The following penalties apply to withdrawn units in most teaching periods after 11.59pm (Melbourne time) on the unit’s census date.

citations.quote: If you withdraw from a unit after a certain date, your academic record may show Withdrawn or Withdrawn Fail.
